seo_description: Tell us about your matter. Every matter starts with a conversation. Contact Gamaliel Consult to discuss how we may be able to help.

hero.heading:
Let’s find your
way forward.
hero.text: Every matter starts with a conversation. Tell us a little about your situation and we’ll be in touch to discuss how we may be able to help.
hero.note: Please do not include confidential documents or sensitive personal information in your initial enquiry.

form.title: Tell us about your matter.
form.disclaimer: Submitting this form does not create a lawyer-client relationship. Any engagement is subject to a conflict check and our written terms.
form.success_message: Thank you. Your message has been sent and we will be in touch soon.

direct.heading:
Prefer to speak
to us directly?
direct.meetings_text: We can arrange an online conversation or discuss an in-person meeting when we respond to your enquiry.
direct.next_text: We aim to respond within two working days. If a deadline is approaching, please make this clear in your message.
direct.image_alt: A meeting room with a long table and tall windows onto trees

expect.title: A clear process from the start.

steps.title: Listen first
steps.text: We take time to understand your circumstances, priorities and concerns.

steps.title: Find the way forward
steps.text: We explain your options, the risks and a practical course of action.

steps.title: Move with purpose
steps.text: We agree the scope and fees, then keep you informed as your matter progresses.

faq.title:
A few useful
answers.
faq.intro: For anything else, just ask. We’ll help you understand the next step.

items.question: What should I include in my enquiry?
items.answer: A short outline of the matter, the people involved and any important dates is enough to begin. Please do not send confidential documents at this stage.

items.question: Can we meet remotely?
items.answer: Yes. We can arrange an online conversation or an in-person meeting, whichever suits you best.

items.question: Does sending this form make me a client?
items.answer: No. Sending this form does not create a lawyer-client relationship. Any engagement is subject to a conflict check and our written terms.
